zones.label: Accurate Information
zones.summary: Use medically accurate, age-appropriate sources rather than rumors.
facts: A clinician can answer personal health questions.

zones.label: Boundaries and Consent
zones.summary: Clear, voluntary, ongoing consent and respected boundaries support safety.
facts: Pressure and coercion are not consent.

zones.label: Barrier Methods
zones.summary: Barrier methods can reduce some infection and pregnancy risks when used correctly.
facts: Methods differ in what they help prevent.
A professional can explain options without shame.

zones.label: Testing and Care
zones.summary: Testing and timely care help identify and treat infections.
facts: Many infections have no obvious symptoms.
Privacy rules and services vary by location.

zones.label: Trusted Support
zones.summary: Trusted adults and qualified professionals can help with questions, access, and safety.
facts: Keep seeking help if the first person does not respond.
